title: The Shilo Sanders bankruptcy trial gets started (and doesn't start well)

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: The Shilo Sanders bankruptcy trial gets started (and doesn't start well)
sources.description: Shilo Sanders, the son of Deion and a member of the Buccaneers during the 2025 offseason program and preseason, hopes to discharge an $11.89 million civil judgment through the federal bankruptcy laws.
